**Ready for the maintainer to merge** after the cut gate is green. This is a read-only review of the diff and the body. No local build ran, by instruction: the release gate runs on the cut runner (`cut.yml` run https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/45253909192, status `queued` at this review).

### What looks good
- Version: `[workspace.package] version = "0.26.0"` in `Cargo.toml`. All 11 member crates use `version.workspace = true`. `Cargo.lock` changes only the 11 `camcraft-*` and `xtask` package versions, 0.25.0 to 0.26.0.
- Scope: the diff has 135 files: `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `RECOMMENDED.md`, `RELEASE_NOTES.md` and 130 deleted `docs/decisions/*.md`. No code changes. No private model or project files are in the diff.
- Breaking: `RELEASE_NOTES.md` starts with "Breaking". `PROJECT_VERSION` is 75 at `v0.25.0` (`crates/app/src/project/file.rs:160`) and 78 on this branch (`file.rs:177`). The steps match the merged PRs: v76 PR #3220, v77 PR #3485, v78 PR #3284. Each PR has a forward step. The part-off kerf change is PR #3472 (`fix(turning)!`), merged after v0.25.0.
- Known issues: the section names #3699 (P1) and 15 open P2 issues. This list is the same as `gh issue list --state open --search 'label:P1,P2'` (16 issues, none missing, none extra).
- Process changes: 122 to 145. Each version 123-145 has its announcement on #681. The branch `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is 145. The note for the held bump of #3737 is in the notes and in the body.
- CHANGELOG.md: 116 added rows. All 116 rows match `| <sha> | <YYYY-MM-DD> | <change> (#N, PR #M) | 0.26.0 |`. No row is a duplicate, no row repeats a row of main, and no row is for a PR that is in `v0.25.0`.
- Sample of 11 rows against the PR `Changelog:` lines and merge commits: PR #3731, #3656, #3507, #3595, #3441, #3502, #3113, #3296, #3151, #3472, #3284. The text and the short merge sha agree in each row.
- Missing rows spot-check: each PR merged since v0.25.0 with a `Changelog:` line other than `none` has a row. The PRs without a row are `PROCESS_VERSION` bumps, a `test(motion)` PR (#3654) and PRs with `Changelog: none` (for example #3737, #3626).
- RECOMMENDED.md: one `## v0.26.0 - decisions gathered at the cut` heading. `docs/decisions/` keeps only `README.md`.
- Body: the cut list (#3701 / PR #3731, PR #3737, PR #3736), the cut line 2026-11-23T19:22Z, and the skipped pixel-snapshot lanes and Windows per-OS readings. The notes say the same in "Pixel snapshots".
- No PR merged to `main` after the cut line except the listed ones. `main` has no commits that this branch does not have.

### Results
- Build and tests: not run here (read-only review, by instruction). The cut gate is the check: run 45253909192.
- Heavy lanes: not run here. The release tier of the cut gate runs them.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
1. Merge only when run 45253909192 is green, and push nothing to the branch after it (release-cut skill, step 3.6).
2. `RECOMMENDED.md` line 71898 has an H1 heading, `# #2929 - A drafted side is not a modelled chamfer`, copied from `docs/decisions/2929-chamfer-drafted-side.md`. The other entries use H2. This is cosmetic.
3. The counts "184 pull requests (36 features, 97 fixes ...)" were not checked exactly. A search of the merged PRs found 172 since the tag commit time, but that search can miss PRs at the tag boundary.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
